description: Conditional nine-frame ceiling for Milestone 1. It contains the six-frame nba_m1_v1 core plus one preselected frame per clip covering pan/blur, a floor-crossing broadcast graphic, and an implausible calibration. Use only if the six-frame result is borderline or its failure-mode coverage proves inadequate; keep the frozen prompts unchanged.
